leveling.usage_text:
`{prefix}leveling enable` - Enable leveling & XP tracking
`{prefix}leveling disable` - Disable leveling system
`{prefix}leveling toggle` - Toggle leveling on/off
`{prefix}levelchannel` - Configure level-up alerts

levelchannel.usage_text:
`{prefix}levelchannel enable` - Enable level-up alerts
`{prefix}levelchannel disable` - Disable level-up alerts
`{prefix}levelchannel toggle` - Toggle alerts on/off
`{prefix}levelchannel set <channel>` - Bind alerts to a channel
`{prefix}levelchannel remove` - Unbind alert channel
`{prefix}levelchannel` - View current settings

reactionrole.help:
**Reaction Roles Commands:**
`!reactionrole add <message_id> <emoji> <role>` - Add a reaction role
`!reactionrole remove <message_id> [emoji]` - Remove reaction role(s)
`!reactionrole list` - List all reaction roles
`!reactionrole create <channel> <title> [description]` - Create a new reaction role message
`!reactionrole update <message_id>` - Update message to show roles
`!reactionrole edit <message_id> [title] [description]` - Edit message title/description

`!cc add <name> <response>` - Create a custom command

`!cc toggle <name>` - Enable or disable a command
